column1: # The frameworks with no module-map header that decls reads from their Headers/ folder (review F29, coordinator ruling 4): every header of
# Headers/, the umbrella header Headers/<Name>.h first when there is one. Any other framework with no module map is an error. A row is a name,
# a TAB and the reason; a row for a framework that has a module map, or that has no header to read, is an error (decls).
# Measured (clang -H closure, and each header preprocessed alone under the Objective-C iOS parse): see each reason.

column2: no module map; the umbrella Headers/vImage.h is read first and every other header of Headers/ with it: the umbrella's closure reaches all 12 top-level headers (clang -H), 886 rows, its shard

no module map; the umbrella Headers/vecLib.h is read first and every other header of Headers/ with it: the umbrella's closure leaves lapack_types.h out, whose 12 typedefs are read too (4,861 rows; 4,849 before this rule); the five other unreached headers preprocess to no code
no module map and no umbrella header: the 11 headers of Headers/ are read as its public set, 298 rows, its shard

no module map; all 7 headers of Headers/ are read, the umbrella first: 5 are guarded by __METAL_VERSION__, the umbrella includes two of them, RealityKitConfig.h is an include guard only; under the Objective-C iOS parse none declares anything (census own=0, foreign=0), so it has no shard
no module map; its one header Headers/_CoreNFC_UIKit.h (the umbrella), 2 rows, its shard
